definitions.gloss: a soft, thick cotton pullover top
definitions.explanation: A casual long-sleeved top made of thick, soft knit fabric, worn for comfort, sports, or relaxing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧でスウェットシャツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}た→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I put on a sweatshirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たいてい→たいてい：01129_taitei⟧スウェットシャツ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧。
examples.english: On days off I usually spend the day in a sweatshirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧スウェットシャツ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏起毛|うらきもう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: This sweatshirt has a fleece lining and is warm.

notes:
A loanword from English "sweatshirt". Often shortened to ⟦スウェット→スウェット：28532_suwetto⟧, which can also refer to matching sweatpants or the fabric itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スウェットシャツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a sweatshirt
- {裏起毛|うらきもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スウェットシャツ: a fleece-lined sweatshirt

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦トレーナー→トレーナー：21469_toreenaa⟧: sweatshirt — a common Japanese term for the same garment
- ⟦パーカー→パーカー：04524_paakaa⟧: hoodie — a sweatshirt with a hood
